https://www.irishmirror.ie/news/irish-ne.text: A man is fighting for his life after he was injured in a mass brawl in south Dublin this week. Sources have told the Irish Mirror that the man, who is in his 20s, was injured when a large number of Romanians started fighting each other at a building in Leopardstown on Saturday evening. He was one of three men injured in the incident at South County Business Park at around 8.15pm. The two other men, also in their 20s, were less seriously injured in the incident and were being treated at St Vincent’s Hospital in south Dublin. But the third man was so seriously injured that he was rushed to Beaumont Hospital in the north of the city - a national centre of excellence for the treatment of serious head injuries. Sources tell us the man is critically ill and there are fears he may not survive his injuries. One man, aged in his 20s, has been arrested and is being detained at a garda station in Dublin. A Garda senior investigating officer has been appointed and the scene is currently preserved for technical examination. An incident room has been set up at Dundrum Garda Station. Gardaí are appealing to anyone who may have witnessed the incident to come forward. Anyone with camera footage, including dash-cam, who was in or around the Vantage Apartments, Central Park, Leopardstown and the South County Business Park, Leopardstown area between 8pm and 9pm on Saturday, is asked to make this footage available to investigating gardaí. Anyone with information is asked to contact Dundrum Garda Station on 01 666 5600, the Garda Confidential Line on 1800 666 111, or any Garda station.
